overview.description: The US Treasury 6 Month Bill ETF (XBIL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is a passively managed, single-bond fund that invests in the most recently issued, on-the-run, 6-month US Treasury Bill. The fund is designed for those specifically required to track the 6-month tenor on the yield curve. XBIL was launched on Mar 7, 2023 and is issued by F/m Investments.
